import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
# Join Source2_72_0 and Source2_72_1 on the "city" column
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by and aggregations
# Group by Source2_72_1.type and Source2_72_0.ride_id
# Aggregations: sum(Source2_72_0.fare), sum(Source2_72_1.driver_count)
grouped = df_joined.groupby(['type', 'ride_id'], as_index=False).agg({
    'fare': 'sum',
    'driver_count': 'sum'
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema: ['type', 'fare', 'ride_id', 'driver_count']
result = grouped[['type', 'fare', 'ride_id', 'driver_count']]

# Ensure data types match target schema
result['type'] = result['type'].astype(str)
result['fare'] = result['fare'].astype(float)
result['ride_id'] = result['ride_id'].astype('int64')
result['driver_count'] = result['driver_count'].astype('int64')

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
